author: Guerrilla Miniature Games
description:
We're back with The Indie Hour Episode Sixty! This series focuses on games you may have never even heard of and gives us an inside look at the wider world of independantly published Tabletop Wargames of all genres.

We're in a weird spot here as the day before I went to review this Spectre Operations expansion, they removed it and launched their Crowdfund! Never one to give up, I figured we'd just use their page to have a look at the game and just keep rolling ahead. Let's check it out!

Check out the already fully funded Crowdfund to see all the new miniatures and preview the hardcover book HERE: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/spectreminiatures/cosmic-horror
title: The GMG Indie Hour Ep 060 - COSMIC HORROR by Spectre Miniatures
